Function bytes_remove_all_matches

pub fn bytes_remove_all_matches<'s>(
    rex: &Regex,
    text: &'s [u8],
) -> Cow<'s, [u8]>
Expand description

Remove all matches of the regex from the text.

When all matches are at the start or end of the input, no new String is allocated and a borrowed slice is returned.
